headline: Bitcoin is back around $80,000 after an overnight dip as oil eases, with a Fed decision Wednesday and Coinbase and Strategy earnings Thursday.

market.asOf: BTC, ETH and SOL read from CoinGecko at about 12:00 UTC Mon 26 Oct (19:00 Bangkok). Fear & Greed from alternative.me's index; CoinMarketCap's own index read 44. Live prices are at the top of the page.
market.fearGreed: 54, Neutral (alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index), up from 51 yesterday

stories.title: Bitcoin climbs back to about $80,400 after an overnight dip as oil eases
stories.summary: Bitcoin dipped below $80,000 during the Asian morning, then recovered to around $80,400 by the European morning. Oil prices eased as regional officials head to Tehran, though Trump says he still has "a decision to make" on Iran. Forced selling of leveraged bets has dropped sharply.
points: Bitcoin was near $80,400 at 7:24am ET, little changed since midnight UTC, after dipping to about $79,300, per CoinDesk.
Cointelegraph puts the weekend low at $79,145 and says bitcoin is on track to end October down about 4%.
Leveraged positions forcibly closed fell 71% to $153M, per CoinDesk.
Brent oil was down 1.28% at $115.23 a barrel and US crude at $101.51 at 07:44 GMT, per Asharq Al-Awsat; CoinDesk puts Brent around $110. The two reports differ.

Trump told Fox News: "I have a decision to make: Do I finish it off... or do I make a deal?" Saudi, Turkish and Pakistani officials were due to meet Iran's leaders in Tehran on Monday, per Asharq Al-Awsat.

stories.title: Fed week: a hold is expected Wednesday, and markets price a December hike
stories.summary: The Fed announces its rate decision on Wednesday and almost everyone expects no change. But markets now see a rate rise in December as likely, as high oil prices feed inflation worries. Inflation (PCE) and growth (GDP) data land Thursday, followed by Coinbase and Strategy earnings that evening.
points: CME FedWatch showed a 90.6% chance of no change this week and 79.7% odds of a December hike, per FXStreet.
In a Reuters poll, 94 of 100 economists expect a hold this week and all 100 expect a hike in December, per Kitco.
Spot bitcoin ETFs (funds that hold bitcoin for stock-market investors) lost $635.6M on 22 Oct, per The Block, and $137.9M on 23 Oct, per Blockchain.news citing Farside.
PCE inflation, out Thursday, is expected at 3.6% a year, up from 3.4%, per Trading Economics.
Robinhood reports Tuesday after the close; Coinbase and Strategy report Thursday after the close, per CoinDesk.

sources.label: The Block: ETFs swing back to outflows

stories.title: Security alert: Electrum wallet bug let rogue servers steal bitcoin
stories.summary: Electrum, a long-running Bitcoin wallet, had a flaw that let a malicious server trick the wallet when a user raised the fee to speed up a payment, so the coins went to the attacker instead. Version 4.8.3 fixes it. If you use Electrum, update and check addresses before you sign.
points: Electrum released version 4.8.3 on 24 Oct; earlier versions remain vulnerable when connected to malicious servers, per CoinDesk.
A first report came in on 11 Oct; a user reported losing funds on 18 Oct. Developers have not disclosed the amount stolen, per CoinDesk.
Users who connect only to trusted servers, including their own, were not exposed, per CoinDesk.
CoinDesk advises checking receiving addresses and amounts before signing any payment.

briefs.title: Solana trading bot Bloom loses about $954K of user SOL
briefs.summary: About 9,408 SOL left 49 user wallets of the Telegram trading bot; Bloom called it a possible third-party compromise and pledged to reimburse users, per Startup Fortune. The cause is not confirmed.

briefs.title: Aviva puts a money market fund share class on the XRP Ledger
briefs.summary: Aviva Investors and Ripple launched a tokenized share class of Aviva's sterling money market fund, with Aviva putting in £50M, per The Block.

briefs.title: South Korea weighs a fourth delay to its crypto tax
briefs.summary: The tax, due 1 Jan 2027, could be pushed to 1 Jan 2029; it would charge 22% on gains above ₩2.5M, per The Block.

briefs.title: Bitcoin and gold are 2026's worst performers so far
briefs.summary: As of 23 Oct, bitcoin was down 7.3% for the year and gold down 7.5%, the two worst of the assets tracked by Charlie Bilello, per Benzinga.

briefs.title: Strategy's latest disclosed bitcoin buy
briefs.summary: Its last filing (19 Oct) reported 267 BTC bought for $22.1M, taking holdings to 848,517 BTC. Strategy reports earnings Thursday.

briefs.title: CoinDCX confirms a $16M loss
briefs.summary: The Indian exchange lost 15.99M USDT from retired deposit wallets days after its CEO called breach reports a false alarm, and says the company absorbed the loss, per The Block.

briefs.title: Ethereum's Glamsterdam test is still on hold
briefs.summary: The Hoodi test-network run of Ethereum's next upgrade, which had been set for today, is postponed with no new date, per Bitcoin Sistemi.

briefs.title: HSBC's Hong Kong dollar stablecoin reaches retail
briefs.summary: HSBC's RedCoin began a phased rollout on 23 Oct to PayMe users, per crypto.news.

calendar.event: Chicago Fed activity index; Dallas Fed manufacturing at 10:30am ET
calendar.note: Chicago Fed index prior -0.04. Dallas Fed (21:30 Bangkok) prior 9.8. No Fed speakers: the Fed is in its quiet period before Wednesday's meeting.

Consensus +0.6% (Investing.com) or +1.8% (Heygotrade); prior revised to -0.1%. At 10:00am ET (21:00 Bangkok): consumer confidence (consensus 80.5 per Heygotrade, 80.0 per Babypips; prior 81.9) and new home sales (forecast 660,000 per Trading Economics; prior 684,000). Galaxy call 8:30am ET; Robinhood and Visa report after the close (Robinhood call 5:00pm ET, 04:00 Wed Bangkok).

Rate 2.75%; most banks expect a hike to 3.00%, Westpac expects a hold, and markets price about 75-80% for a hike (Newsquawk). Australia's inflation data also comes Wednesday: 4.2% a year expected, prior 4.0% (InvestingLive).

Rate 2.25%. In a Reuters poll, 19 of 34 economists expect a hike to 2.50%; markets price above 80% (InvestingLive). The Bank of Thailand also meets on Wednesday: rate 1.00%, which Focus Economics expects to stay there through end-2026.

Range 3.75-4.00%. 94 of 100 economists in a Reuters poll expect a hold (Kitco); CME FedWatch showed 90.6% for a hold and 79.7% for a December hike (FXStreet, 26 Oct). Chair Warsh's press conference 2:30pm ET (01:30 Bangkok).
Both report after the US close. Alphabet call 4:30pm ET; Microsoft call 5:30pm ET (04:30 Thu Bangkok).

calendar.event: US Q3 GDP (advance) and September PCE inflation
calendar.note: GDP: consensus 3.2% (Investing.com), 3.1% (Babypips) or 3.0% (Newsquawk); prior 2.2%. PCE: 3.6% y/y expected, prior 3.4%; core PCE 3.1% expected, prior 3.0% (Trading Economics). Jobless claims: consensus 196,000 (Trading Economics) or 198,000 (Investing.com), prior 194,000. ECB decision at 9:15am ET (20:15 Bangkok): deposit rate 2.50%, hold expected.

Results after the US close; Coinbase Q&A, Strategy webinar and Amazon call at 5:00pm ET. Token unlocks the same day: FF ~$20.1M and CARDS ~$18.2M, per the unlock data on this page. The Bank of Japan decides on Fri 30 Oct: a hold at 1.25% is expected.

At 08:00 UTC. About $12.2B with max pain at $79,000 (CryptoTicker, 17 Oct) or $10.7-11.3B with max pain at $78,000-79,000 (Crypto Briefing, 8 Oct). These estimates are over a week old. Max pain is not a price target.

Consensus +0.8%, prior +0.9%; Trading Economics forecasts +0.6%. Chicago PMI at 9:45am ET: consensus 54.8 (Investing.com), prior 58.8. Fed's Daly speaks at 12:00pm ET (23:00 Bangkok) and Musalem at 12:30pm ET (23:30 Bangkok).
